data.one_liner: Collect in‑app feedback and send it to Sentry.
data.what_it_does: Provides a BetterFeedback widget that captures user screenshots, comments and optional contact info. When submitted, the feedback is uploaded to Sentry as a user feedback event. It builds on the `feedback` package and integrates with `sentry_flutter`.
use_when: You need in‑app user feedback tied to Sentry error tracking
You already use the `feedback` package and want Sentry integration
You want a quick, low‑code way to report bugs from the UI
avoid_when: You do not use Sentry as your backend
You require a custom feedback backend or more advanced UI
You need a platform‑specific feedback solution not covered by this wrapper
strengths: Simple API – just wrap your app with BetterFeedback
Automatic upload to Sentry’s user feedback feature
weaknesses: Works only with Sentry as the backend
Limited customization of the feedback UI
data.setup_notes: Follow the normal `sentry_flutter` setup (DSN, initialization) then add `feedback_sentry` to pubspec and wrap the app with BetterFeedback.

alternatives.name: sentry_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: Directly use Sentry’s SDK without the extra feedback wrapper

alternatives.name: sentry
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you only need to send events to Sentry and handle feedback yourself
